\section{\texttt{JsonJobStore}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.jobs.JsonJobStore}\index{Classes!JsonJobStore}

Job store that persists one JSON file per job under a root directory.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
JsonJobStore(self, root: str | Path) -> None
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{root}] \texttt{str \textbar{} Path}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}Files are written as \texttt{\{root\}/\allowbreak{}\{job\_\allowbreak{}id\}.\allowbreak{}json} with indented JSON, so jobs are easy to inspect and survive process restarts. A lock guards in-process concurrent writes.
\apifield{Source}\texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}jobs.\allowbreak{}py:168}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/b6cbc710ffdfa5f26f700c999d594c67588c1e16/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/jobs.py#L168}{online}), class, module \cref{module:feedback_intelligence_agent.jobs}
